name: open-profile-from-drawer
description: Walks Jetchat's real navigation edge: launch the conversation, open the modal drawer from the app bar, and pick a recent profile to land on the profile fragment. Jetchat is a Fragment host driving Compose content, so the drawer-over-conversation state and the conversation-to-profile fragment transition are not reachable from any single @Preview — every frame here is the real NavActivity after a real click. The two label-only steps let the drawer's open animation settle before the next click; the renderer advances the animation clock one step at a time, so the drawer sheet is still sliding in at step 1.
